stem: A neonate has recurrent afebrile focal seizures. Which investigation is most appropriate to look for an underlying structural brain abnormality?
explanation: Recurrent neonatal focal seizures are concerning for structural or other serious pathology, and MRI brain is an appropriate investigation when clinically stable and available.
